                        # Conversation Summary: codx-junior-ui Mobile Layout Design

## Context
Design document (AS IS → TO BE) for adding mobile support to **codx-junior-ui**, a Vue.js desktop docking panel application.

---

## AS IS: Desktop Architecture

- **Root component:** `Desktop.vue` using `dockview-vue` library
- **19 registered dockable panels** (chat, tasks, files, wiki, kanban, knowledge, settings, etc.)
- **Panel lifecycle:** `$ui.showTab(name)` → `addAppPanel()` → `dockviewApi.addPanel()`
- **Persistence:** `dockviewApi.toJSON()` → `localStorage['dockview-layout']`
- **Rendering:** `renderer: 'always'` — all panels stay mounted in DOM simultaneously
- **Tab system:** Custom `Tab.vue` component per panel
- **Store integrations:** `$ui` (open apps, tab management) + `$chats` (chat rehydration on restore)
- **Auto-save triggers:** `onDidAddPanel`, `onDidRemovePanel`, `onDidLayoutChange`

### Key Limitations
- No mobile layout exists
- `renderer: 'always'` causes high memory usage with 19 panels
- `$ui` and `$chats` store contracts undocumented
- No deep linking / URL navigation
- No responsive breakpoints

---

## TO BE: Mobile Layout Design

### Core Principle
> Same stores + same panel components, different shell. `Desktop.vue` untouched.

### Device Routing (`App.vue`)
```
isMobile (window.innerWidth < 768) → <MobileLayout />
else → <Desktop />
```

### Shell Structure (`MobileLayout.vue`)
- **TopAppBar** — title + hamburger + notifications + avatar
- **Main area** — `<keep-alive :include="recentViews" :max="3">` wrapping active component
- **BottomNavBar** — 4 tabs: Tasks | Chat | Files | More
- **MoreDrawer** — bottom sheet grid with all 14 remaining panels

### Panel Priority Tiers
| Tier | Panels | Cache Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Primary | `tasks`, `chat`, `files` | Always cached, eagerly loaded |
| Secondary | `activity`, `projects`, `wiki`, `docs`, `profiles` | `defineAsyncComponent`, cached up to max=3 |
| Tertiary | `metrics`, `log-viewer`, `knowledge`, `knowledge_settings`, `settings`, `global-settings`, `account`, `file-finder`, `home` | Lazy loaded, not cached |

### Memory Strategy
- Replaces `renderer: 'always'` with `<keep-alive :max="3">`
- FIFO eviction of non-primary panels from cache
- `defineAsyncComponent` for secondary + tertiary panels

### State Persistence (`useMobileLayout.js`)
- Storage key: `mobile-layout`
- Saves: `{ activeView, recentViews }` to `localStorage`
- Restores on `onMounted`

### New Files
```
client/src/components/mobile/
  MobileLayout.vue
  BottomNavBar.vue
  TopAppBar.vue
  MoreDrawer.vue
client/src/composables/
  useDevice.js
  useMobileLayout.js
```
**Modified:** `App.vue` only  
**Untouched:** `Desktop.vue`, all 19 panel components

### Mobile UX Details
- Default view: `KanbanContainer` (tasks)
- `height: 100dvh` for dynamic viewport
- `env(safe-area-inset-*)` for notch/home bar support
- `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` for iOS momentum scroll
- MoreDrawer renders as 3-column icon grid bottom sheet

### Deferred Items
- Deep linking (Vue Router integration needed)
- External wiki iframe/link strategy
- Auth/session management
- Full `$ui` / `$chats` store contracts for mobile chat hydration

---

# Task Description: Create `BottomNavBar.vue` Mobile Component

## Overview
Create a bottom navigation bar component for the mobile layout of **codx-junior-ui**. This component is part of the new mobile shell architecture that sits alongside `MobileLayout.vue`, `TopAppBar.vue`, and `MoreDrawer.vue`. It must integrate seamlessly with the existing `$ui` store pattern and the `useMobileLayout.js` composable.

---

## File Location
```
client/src/components/mobile/BottomNavBar.vue
```

---

## Component Structure
Follow the project's Vue component structure: `<script setup>` → `<template>` → `<script>` (export default).

---

## Functional Requirements

### Tabs (exactly 4, in order)
| Tab | View Name | Icon Suggestion |
|-----|-----------|-----------------|
| Tasks | `'tasks'` | ✅ checklist / kanban icon |
| Chat | `'chat'` | 💬 chat bubble icon |
| Files | `'files'` | 📁 folder icon |
| More | `'more'` | ⋯ grid / dots icon |

### Props
- `activeView` (String, required) — the currently active view name; used to highlight the matching tab with an active state (different color/weight).

### Emits
- `navigate` — emitted when any tab is tapped, with the view name as payload:
  - Tasks → `emit('navigate', 'tasks')`
  - Chat → `emit('navigate', 'chat')`
  - Files → `emit('navigate', 'files')`
  - More → `emit('navigate', 'more')` ← triggers `MoreDrawer` in parent

---

## Styling Requirements

### Layout
- Fixed at the **bottom of the viewport** (`position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0`)
- Full width
- `z-index` high enough to overlay content (e.g., `z-50` in Tailwind)
- Use **`env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`** for bottom padding to support the iOS home bar

### Visual Design
- Each tab is a vertical flex column: icon on top, label below
- Active tab should be visually distinct (e.g., primary color, bold text)
- Inactive tabs should use a muted/secondary color
- Use TailwindCSS classes only — **no custom CSS**
- Use `scoped` styles if absolutely necessary for `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` padding (since Tailwind cannot express this directly)

---

## Implementation Notes

- Use **Vue 3 Composition API** structure
- `<script setup>` section contains **only imports** — no logic, no variables
- All reactive data goes in `data()`, computed properties in `computed`, methods in `methods` of the `export default` object
- Use **inline SVG icons** or Unicode symbols for tab icons (no external icon library assumed)
- No semicolons in JS/TS code
- Keep methods short and focused

---

## Integration Context

This component will be used inside `MobileLayout.vue` like:
```vue
<BottomNavBar :activeView="activeView" @navigate="onNavigate" />
```

Where `onNavigate` either sets the active view directly (for `tasks`, `chat`, `files`) or opens the `MoreDrawer` (for `more`).

---

## Example Skeleton

```vue client/src/components/mobile/BottomNavBar.vue
<script setup>
// imports only
</script>

<template>
  <!-- fixed bottom bar, full width, safe-area padding -->
  <!-- 4 tabs: Tasks | Chat | Files | More -->
  <!-- each tab: icon + label, active state via activeView prop -->
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'BottomNavBar',
  props: {
    activeView: { type: String, required: true }
  },
  emits: ['navigate'],
  data() {
    return {
      tabs: [
        { name: 'tasks', label: 'Tasks', icon: '...' },
        { name: 'chat',  label: 'Chat',  icon: '...' },
        { name: 'files', label: 'Files', icon: '...' },
        { name: 'more',  label: 'More',  icon: '...' }
      ]
    }
  },
  methods: {
    onTabTap(viewName) {
      this.$emit('navigate', viewName)
    }
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
/* only for env(safe-area-inset-bottom) */
</style>
```
